data.one_liner: Provides over 7000+ material icons from the Material Design Icons project.
data.what_it_does: This package integrates thousands of Material Design Icons into your Flutter application. It exposes them as static constants that can be used directly with the standard Icon widget, and includes metadata such as tags, styles, and versioning.
use_when: You need a vast collection of icons beyond the standard Flutter material set.
You want easy access to MDI icons via static IconData constants.
You need access to icon metadata like tags, versions, or deprecation notices.
avoid_when: You only require the default Material icons shipped with Flutter.
You are concerned about app binary size and only need a handful of icons.
strengths: Over 7000+ icons available out of the box.
Metadata enriched with tags, styles, and version info.
Iterable structure allowing easy iteration or filtering via MdiIcons.values.
weaknesses: Large number of icons may impact app asset size if not tree-shaken properly.
Not documented if font sub-setting is supported.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: cupertino_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Apple's Cupertino style icons over Material Design Icons.
